one_liner: Bitey, attention-hungry prankster who calls herself 'Windy-chan', ends sentences in 'noda', and wants to be the baddest 'waru'.
personality: A mischievous self-styled villain ('waru') who growls 'Gao~!', threatens to bite ('gabu!') and pulls pranks mostly because she wants to be noticed - her profile tagline is literally 'if you ignore her, she bites'. She bosses the trainer around as her 'henchman' but shows a soft side: she worries about the trainer's troubles, feels odd that the trainer gets scolded with her, and is touched when people gather around her. Childlike in tastes (corn, beetles, snowball fights) and obsessed with brushing and sharpening her teeth.

story_arc.summary: Windy wants everyone to look at her and sets out to be the greatest 'waru', racing on dirt over mile-to-middle distances (Unicorn S, Japan Dirt Derby, Tokai S, February S, Teio Sho, Champions Cup). Event titles track her growth from 'Look at me more!' after her debut and a 'windfall' Unicorn S, through 'I won't make mistakes again' at the Tokai S and a 'roar at dawn' at the February S, to 'the strongest waru' after the Champions Cup. Her real namesake won the 1997 February Stakes, the first dirt G1 in JRA history.
story_arc.source: event titles (trainee_event_titles); real-horse February S fact is general knowledge (unverified)
